## sub_581C20_00581c20 — Dual list destruction with SEH-guarded callback cleanup

**Summary:** Destroys two embedded linked lists with SEH-protected cleanup. First list (this+0x10): calls SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling on each node's data, frees data and wrapper. Second list (this+0x0): calls NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH with arg 84 on adjusted data pointer, then frees data and wrappers. Optionally closes handle at this+0x20. Zeros all 8 list fields.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Called by:** (none static — top-level or indirect-only)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| *(obj+0x0) | 0x0 | R | — | Node's data pointer (checked for null; passed to SEH handler or callback loop) |
| *(this+0x14) | 0x4 | R | — | List1 tail pointer read during traversal |
| obj | 0x0 | R | — | Node data pointer — first pass passes to SEHGuardedFunction; second pass adjusts and passes to NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH |
| obj | 0x8 | R | — | Byte flag: non-zero means cleanup function should be invoked on data |
| this | 0x0 | RW | 0 | List2 head pointer; zeroed after destruction |
| this | 0x4 | RW | 0 | List2 tail pointer; zeroed after destruction |
| this | 0x8 | RW | 0 | List2 cursor/iterator; zeroed after destruction |
| this | 0xC | RW | 0 | List2 element count; zeroed after destruction |
| this | 0x10 | RW | 0 | List1 head pointer; zeroed after first pass |
| this | 0x14 | RW | 0 | List1 tail pointer; zeroed after first pass |
| this | 0x18 | RW | 0 | List1 cursor/iterator; zeroed after first pass |
| this | 0x1C | RW | 0 | List1 element count; zeroed after first pass |
| this | 0x20 | RW | 0 | Handle field; closed then zeroed if flag at +0x28 is set |
| this | 0x28 | R | — | Byte flag controlling whether handle at +0x20 is closed |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x0–0x1C: Zeroed at end of destruction. No longer valid after call.
- this 0x20: Zeroed after successful CloseHandle. Survives unchanged if no handle close.

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|
| 005867b0 | SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling | R | Called on first-list data items with SEH protection |
| 0059cb70 | SEH_581C20 | R | Exception handler registration for this function |
| 0059e1a8 | CloseHandle | R | Close handle at this+0x20 if flag at this+0x28 is true |

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| 005867b0 | SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling | Invoke callback with exception handling on first-list data; used as callback for second-list NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH |
| 00587bcf | FreeWrapper_7bcf | Free data objects and all node wrappers |
| 0058a5f7 | NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH | Callback loop on second-list data with size 84 and SEH protection |

**Guard conditions:** Checks byte at this+0x28 (handle-close flag). If non-zero AND CloseHandle succeeds, handle at this+0x20 is zeroed. For each node: checks byte at node+0x8 AND data pointer at node+0x0 before invoking cleanup. Second pass additionally checks that data's first dword is non-null before calling NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH.
